Man Arrested In Connection To Burglary, Threats Posted: Updated: 
FRANKFORT, Ky. (LEX 18)-- Police have charged a man who they say is behind a burglary and numerous threats toward police. 
Officials say 24-year-old Rueben Ruffin broke into an apartment last Wednesday, vandalizing the place and spray-painting threats on the wall. 
They say he also phoned in threats to 911 later that same night. 
The sheriff's special operations unit tracked him down at a Frankfort hotel Wednesday morning. 
He's charged with terroristic threatening and police say more charges are possible.
